def mvcc.cancelState (σ : mvcc.WsState) (wa : Loc) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) (Ws Wu : GMap Loc
    mvcc.WatchRange) (VB : List (GMap Loc mvcc.EventBatch)) : mvcc.WsState :=
  { Lmu := σ.Lmu, Ws := Ws, Wu := Wu,
    ST :=
      <[wa :=
        { minRev := st.minRev, victim := st.victim, compacted := st.compacted, restore := st.restore, ch := null }]>σ.ST,
    Wo := σ.Wo, M := σ.M, E := GMap.delete wa σ.E, vs := σ.vs, vbs := σ.vbs, VB := VB }

theorem mvcc.state_acc (σ : mvcc.WsState) (wa : Loc) (st0 : mvcc.WatcherSt) (qf : Qp) (h : σ.ST !!
    wa = some st0 ∧ qf = 1 ∨ σ.Wo !! wa = some st0 ∧ qf = Qp.half 1) : (([∗map] w ↦ st ∈ σ.ST,
    mvcc.watcherOwn w st) ∗ [∗map] w ↦ st ∈ σ.Wo, mvcc.watcherOwn w st (Qp.half 1)) ⊢

    w st) ∗ [∗map] w ↦ st ∈ σ.Wo, mvcc.watcherOwn w st (Qp.half 1))

theorem mvcc.delete_none {V : Type} (m : GMap Loc V) (k : Loc) (h : m !! k = none) : GMap.delete k m
    = m

theorem mvcc.findSome?_none_of {α β : Type} (g : α → Option β) (l : List α) (h : ∀ (j : Nat) (x :
    α), l[j]? = some x → g x = none) : List.findSome? g l = none

theorem mvcc.lookup_insert' {V : Type} (m : GMap Loc V) (k w : Loc) (v : V) : <[k := v]>m !! w = if
    w = k then some v else m !! w

theorem mvcc.vb_delete (σ : mvcc.WsState) (hok : mvcc.WsOk σ) (k : Nat) (B : GMap Loc
    mvcc.EventBatch) (wa : Loc) (hk : σ.VB[k]? = some B) (hwa : (B !! wa).isSome = true) : (∀ (w :
    Loc), List.findSome? (fun x => x !! w) (σ.VB.set k (GMap.delete wa B)) = if w = wa then none
    else σ.victimOf w) ∧ ∀ (i j : Nat) (B1 B2 : GMap Loc mvcc.EventBatch) (w : Loc), (σ.VB.set k
    (GMap.delete wa B))[i]? = some B1 → (σ.VB.set k (GMap.delete wa B))[j]? = some B2 → (B1 !!
    w).isSome = true → (B2 !! w).isSome = true → i = j

theorem mvcc.memberRes_live_elim (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (q : Qp) (σ : mvcc.WsState) (w : Loc) (st :
    mvcc.WatcherSt) (h : σ.live w) : mvcc.memberRes γ q σ w st ⊢ ∃ γw r fcs evsw d, ⌜σ.M !! w = some
    γw⌝ ∗ mvcc.watcherMeta γ w γw ∗ mvcc.watcherFixed w r fcs ∗ mvcc.watcherChan γ w γw st.ch ∗ ⌜σ.E
    !! w = some (evsw, d)⌝ ∗ monoListAuthOwn γw.evs q.half evsw ∗ dghostVar γw.live (DFrac.own
    q.half) true

theorem mvcc.findSome?_isSome_of {α β : Type} (g : α → Option β) (l : List α) (n : Nat) (x : α) (hn
    : l[n]? = some x) (hx : (g x).isSome = true) : (List.findSome? g l).isSome = true

theorem mvcc.findSome?_set_eq {α β : Type} (g : α → Option β) (l : List α) (k : Nat) (x x' : α) :
    l[k]? = some x → g x' = g x → List.findSome? g (l.set k x') = List.findSome? g l

theorem mvcc.lookup_delete' {V : Type} (m : GMap Loc V) (k w : Loc) : GMap.delete k m !! w = if w =
    k then none else m !! w

theorem mvcc.zip_set_right {α β : Type} (l1 : List α) (l2 : List β) (n : Nat) (a : α) (b : β) :
    l1[n]? = some a → (l1.zip l2).set n (a, b) = l1.zip (l2.set n b)
